title: [trixie] `test_rexec_without_password_input` in sonic-utilities is hanging on Trixie
author: saiarcot895
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

The `test_rexec_without_password_input` test case in `sonic-utilities` has been hanging on Python 3.13 on Trixie. Specifically, when the code is trying to read the password, the pytest process is getting the SIGTTOU signal, suggesting that two processes want to write to the terminal at the same time.

### Steps to Reproduce

In the `trixie` branch, in `src/sonic-utilities/tests/remote_cli_test.py`, remove the skip decorator for the `test_rexec_without_password_input` test cases. Then, run that test case via pytest.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Tests should pass.

comments.author: anders-nexthop
comments.body:
@saiarcot895 

The root cause of the hang is that Python 3.13 is more defensive about TTY interaction. When a TTY is accessed from a background process (such as when running tests under pytest), Python will send SIGTTOU/SIGTTIN signals (depending on whether it's a write or read operation). This affects `getpass.getpass()`, so any code using `getpass` in background contexts (scripts, daemons, or test suites) needs to be updated to handle these signals properly.

Here's a commit with a proposed fix (all sonic-utilities unit tests pass with this fix):
```
commit 296404cebe1711c02ff8ba4c1e62cd730c79ecda (HEAD)
Author: Anders Linn <anders@nexthop.ai>
Date:   Thu Sep 11 20:32:43 2025 +0000

    Issue 23798: Wrap getpass.getpass in a signal handler to avoid SIGTTOU

    Python 3.13 will raise a SIGTTOU signal when getpass.getpass is called
    in a background process, like when running under pytest. Wrap the call
    in a signal handler to ignore the signal and avoid hanging.

diff --git a/tests/remote_cli_test.py b/tests/remote_cli_test.py
index bf34f537..e68ba5f2 100644
--- a/tests/remote_cli_test.py
+++ b/tests/remote_cli_test.py
@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
 import os
+import signal
 from click.testing import CliRunner
 import paramiko
 from rcli import rexec
@@ -13,6 +14,7 @@ import socket
 import termios
 import getpass
 import pytest
+import signal

 MULTI_LC_REXEC_OUTPUT = '''======== LINE-CARD0|sonic-lc1 output: ========
 hello world
@@ -82,7 +84,18 @@ def mock_getpass(prompt="Password:", stream=None):


 class TestRemoteExec(object):
-    __getpass = getpass.getpass
+    # Store the original function at class definition time to avoid recursion
+    _original_getpass = getpass.getpass
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def __getpass(prompt="Password:", stream=None):
+        """SIGTTOU-safe wrapper for getpass.getpass() for Python 3.13 compatibility"""
+        original_sigttou_handler = signal.signal(signal.SIGTTOU, signal.SIG_IGN)
+        try:
+            # Call the original function, in case getpass.getpass has been overridden
+            return TestRemoteExec._original_getpass(prompt, stream)
+        finally:
+            signal.signal(signal.SIGTTOU, original_sigttou_handler)

     @classmethod
     def setup_class(cls):
@@ -220,16 +233,14 @@ class TestRemoteExec(object):

     @mock.patch("sonic_py_common.device_info.is_chassis", mock.MagicMock(return_value=True))
     @mock.patch("os.getlogin", mock.MagicMock(return_value="admin"))
-    @pytest.mark.skip(reason="Causes test case to get stuck in Trixie slave container")
     def test_rexec_without_password_input(self):
-        # TODO(trixie): figure out why SIGTTOU is being sent during
-        # getpass.getpass, and if it needs to be ignored.
         runner = CliRunner()
         getpass.getpass = TestRemoteExec.__getpass
         LINECARD_NAME = "all"
-        result = runner.invoke(
-            rexec.cli, [LINECARD_NAME, "-c", "show version"])
+
+        result = runner.invoke(rexec.cli, [LINECARD_NAME, "-c", "show version"])
         getpass.getpass = mock_getpass
+
         print(result.output)
         assert result.exit_code == 1, result.output
         assert "Aborted" in result.output
(END)
```
Do you want me to submit this somewhere? or is it easier for you to just commit it in your branch?

#### What I did

Python 3.13 will raise a SIGTTOU signal when getpass.getpass is called in a background process, like when running under pytest. Add a signal handler to `tests/remote_cli_test.py` to handle SIGTTOU whenever `getpass.getpass()` is called, since this will raise SIGTTOU when running `trixie`.

This closes [#23798](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/23798)

#### How I did it

Wrap the call in a signal handler to ignore the signal. This avoids a hang when running `trixie`.

comments.author: BYGX-wcr
comments.body: We mocked getpass at the setup phase of the class and only recovered it at the end of the UT. How will the original getpass be invoked during test?

comments.author: anders-nexthop
comments.body:
> We mocked getpass at the setup phase of the class and only recovered it at the end of the UT. How will the original getpass be invoked during test?

We explicitly re-assign it in `test_rexec_without_password_input()`, which overrides the mock for the duration of the test:
```
    def test_rexec_without_password_input(self):
        runner = CliRunner()
        getpass.getpass = TestRemoteExec.__getpass
        LINECARD_NAME = "all"
        result = runner.invoke(
            rexec.cli, [LINECARD_NAME, "-c", "show version"])

        result = runner.invoke(rexec.cli, [LINECARD_NAME, "-c", "show version"])
        getpass.getpass = mock_getpass

        print(result.output)
        assert result.exit_code == 1, result.output
        assert "Aborted" in result.output
```
